description:
We're circling back around to a video from Matt Whitman from the 10 Minute Bible Hour (@TenMinuteBibleHour) who had a discussion with three Adventists on various aspects of SDA theology. In part 2, they transition to talking about the Trinity and Ellen G. White. 

Part 1: https://youtube.com/live/enA1wRaIPvo
